SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT CSTMR_ID, DLVRY_PLAN_NO, ORDR_NO, ORDR_SEQ FROM KEPCON.KEPWMGI03 GI03 WHERE CSTMR_ID = 'KRHSDE0003C001' AND SND_CHK = 'N' AND USE_CHK = 'Y' ORDER BY CSTMR_ID, ORDR_NO, ORDR_SEQ, DLVRY_PLAN_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT F_SPLIT(SO04.IF_DEAL_STTMN_DTAIL,'^',1) AS PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID , F_SPLIT(SO04.IF_DEAL_STTMN_DTAIL,'^',2) AS REVISION_NUM , TO_CHAR(GI03.FRST_REGST_DATM,'YYYYMMDD') AS CONFIRM_DATE , 'Y' AS ORDER_CONFIRMATION , GI03.DLVRY_PLAN_DATE AS SUPPLIER_SUGGEST_DATE , nvl(GI03.NOTE,' ') AS SUPPLIER_REMARK FROM KEPCON.KEPWMGI03 GI03, KEPCON.KEPMPSO06 SO06, KEPCON.KEPMPSO04 SO04 WHERE GI03.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND GI03.DLVRY_PLAN_NO = '$G_RS.DLVRY_PLAN_NO$' AND GI03.ORDR_NO = '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$' AND GI03.ORDR_SEQ = $G_RS.ORDR_SEQ$ AND GI03.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND GI03.CSTMR_ID = SO06.CSTMR_ID AND GI03.ORDR_NO = SO06.ORDR_NO AND GI03.ORDR_SEQ = SO06.ORDR_SEQ AND GI03.CSTMR_ID = SO04.CSTMR_ID AND SO06.ORDR_RE_NO = SO04.ORDR_RE_NO AND SO06.ORDR_RE_SEQ= SO04.ORDR_RE_SEQ ORDER BY GI03.CSTMR_ID, GI03.ORDR_NO, GI03.ORDR_SEQ, GI03.DLVRY_PLAN_NO
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPWMGI03 SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND DLVRY_PLAN_NO = '$G_RS.DLVRY_PLAN_NO$' AND ORDR_NO= '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$' AND ORDR_SEQ= $G_RS.ORDR_SEQ$
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPWMGI03 SET SND_CHK = 'E' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND DLVRY_PLAN_NO = '$G_RS.DLVRY_PLAN_NO$' AND ORDR_NO= '$G_RS.ORDR_NO$' AND ORDR_SEQ= $G_RS.ORDR_SEQ$
